statement.p: Find the equation of the tangent plane to the surface determined by x^2 y^3 + z - 25 = 0 at x=4, y=3.

static.solution: z = f(x,y) = 25-x^{2}y^{3}, and f(4,3) = -407. We have f_x(x,y) = -\left(2xy^{3}\right),\quad \hbox{ so}\quad f_x(4,3) = -216, and f_y(x,y) = -\left(x^{2}\cdot 3y^{2}\right),\quad \hbox{ so}\quad f_y(4,3) = -432. Thus, the tangent plane is z = f(4,3) + f_x(4,3)(x - 4) + f_y(4,3)(y - 3), or z = -407 - 216 (x - 4) - 432 (y - 3) = -\left(407+216\mathopen{}\left(x-4\right)+432\mathopen{}\left(y-3\right)\right).
